name: Entropy Helios
author: behn1220
tagline: Dual-core 8-voice ambient drone synth with ENTROPY & PURE HW modes
description: Entropy Helios turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into two instruments in one: ENTROPY Mode (a dual-core generative ambient drone synthesizer with 18 handcrafted presets and 8 user slots) and PURE HW Mode (16 blank INIT hardware slots with zero generative interference). Features 6 five-oscillator drone voices, 2 melodic voices with dual 5-step sequencers, 12 bottom-row touch plates, dual analog-modeled VCFs, a 3-spring reverb tank, 16 stackable FX cartridges, an 8x8 modular CV pin matrix, a 3-band parametric master EQ, live USB Audio FX processing, and a full WebMIDI Hardware Studio.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal, felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments), dual flash chipset support by Laurens (@profikid), and DSP helpers by Styves Goupil.
